#
Happy Labor Day, team! Today, and really every day, is a great reminder that when workers join together, they are often better able to secure livable wages, a safe work environment, and quality benefits for families. Across the country, we’re seeing workers and organized labor mobilize and join in solidarity to strike for better wages, benefits, and working conditions. Workers are taking a firm stance: they will not settle for lower wages and unfair working conditions. And we’re fortunate enough to have the most pro-labor President, Joe Biden, in office right now — and a pro-labor ticket in Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. I will continue to do everything in my power to support the labor movement. From supporting the _PRO Act_ in the Senate to calling on company leaders to level the playing field for their employees, **I’m keeping up the fight to support our workers.** Folks, labor built this country. Today, we celebrate what the right to organize has achieved for working people: the dignity of a fair wage and benefits and the respect of a safe workplace. If you enjoy your weekends, paid leave, fair wages, and so many other benefits, thank a union member today. It’s their hard work, and the fights from workers before us, that made this all possible. subject: Campaign Update
body:
The Walworth County Fair, my work to secure our elections, and a town hall this week at UW-Milwaukee.

logo

64 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:

Walworth County Fair

Last week, I stopped by the 175th Annual Walworth County Fair. The fair was hopping as kids were showing their animals and the meat auction was busy as usual.

It was also great to see some of our hard working volunteers. I’m grateful for all their hard work.

I also joined Newsmax live from the fair to talk about the impact rising costs are having on Wisconsin families. Here’s what it looked like behind the scenes:
Click Here to Watch My Interview (https://www.newsmax.com/newsmax-tv/bryan-steil-kamala-harris-border/2024/08/28/id/1178258/)

Working to Secure Our Elections

Last week, I subpoenaed top officials at five government agencies for documents and information related to President Biden’s recent executive order that authorizes taxpayer dollars to be used by federal agencies to get-out-the-vote across the country.

These are also known as Bidenbucks.

If left unchecked, taxpayer dollars could be used by partisan federal agencies in voter registration and ultimately influence our elections.

Elections are partisan, but our election administration should never be partisan.
Click Here to Read More (https://www.foxnews.com/politics/gop-chairman-subpeonas-biden-officials-appear-sworn-depositions-voter-mobilization-eo)

Agenda 47 Policy Tour in Milwaukee

On Thursday, I encourage you to join me, Doug Burgum, Tommy Thompson, and Monica Crowley for a town hall to discuss the economic failures of the Biden/Harris administration.

The town hall will begin at 7:00 pm in the Jan Serr Studio at UW-Milwaukee.

Click the link below to get tickets!

On Wisconsin,

Bryan Steil

subject: Every day it got worse

body:
I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbWqSLnHgXMFnNoypwoPjY60xXSxu925AnZz8I2-5pLdpoJloKSAFF6d1gIpWS1oL3Qq5HfUIL5XFgaOLnbF3zQKuksi40Zgu61SsDkdEUe4K0DyNrayW6TAZzhZNnIEhDhAeEjb_ojP-Fggu0D22mH060XMWFrBY9QjqS7-frWhvs727_SWpDxDx0mBmv2i3Nv0l6mwCzRtSVOF88bqgUo1yiZchdwssnFyEE5pF9YrmFEgsN9iJmHgXQNiYbq2eO5cpCsApTauBiat17fIOPe_tFnxh4xPgNLyyHYqjOzj8OXSebY1hzoF_LDlfz7EJvg4GzXiiXSB499hw11ICfxUWuWi4DBdYkhFLR7cWOitE%3D)

---
Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbWqSLnHgXMFnNoypwoPjY60xXSxu925AnZz8I2-5pLdpoJloKSAFF6d1gIpWS1oL3Qq5HfUIL5XFgaOLnbF3zQKuksi40Zgu61SsDkdEUe4K0DyNrayW6TAZzhZNnIEhDhAeEjb_ojP-Fggu0D22mH060XMWFrBY9QjqS7-frWhvs727_SWpDxDx0mBmv2i3Nv0l6mwCzRtSVOF88bqgUo_8xW0upEgIuDxoJqZVfqkxjn9aWeF5wS8jqVrzRRsiWjV8fbluUzRIhsz7yvUAD_Jnt8W87P8a-2Fd5PZf7kA-UJANlCjZImQ7Xk4eM6dJ7aXSf6R-vKkvyQjKlqwkfHsqcD1X5geXTJ6OfLR2uzTA%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbWqSLnHgXMFnNoypwoPjY60xXSxu925AnZz8I2-5pLdpoJloKSAFF6d1gIpWS1oL3Qq5HfUIL5XFgaOLnbF3zQKuksi40Zgu61SsDkdEUe4K0DyNrayW6TAZzhZNnIEhDhAeEjb_ojP-Fggu0D22mH060XMWFrBY9QjqS7-frWhvs727_SWpDxDx0mBmv2i3Nv0l6mwCzRtSVOF88bqgUo2eVPh6h-uzTMWa2beYW_kwTQl63Yvc4Hvm8f4tIRMS8XqXE8MA1jVf11nlB_rg_oAnWefgzDo1HvsXdRnPDLgJeFonKGsrYYhdlRCa39UiVZBMmoaSGcu2xGDbE-lRzhFql4n_23dfKiqPLyLdO3qs%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbexL2Z0G3xET6LC_yo5cfuQDgJaSIiwi8-wTTfUqCIL9pgJU0hSYdmVnRJzDWq8suJ97Y7rwggSAU7gsuLH_ud9R7mC7c4Vv1LoqlQx_sQjQZZqfDAt4HovwPoK6kbHK-ByvpAT5-HeU1V3mOvCEjsGA_uosqMOtp3vXFG_isyb_cYsyvcfvRjMVxAYxPVvv4S9ni-Zlkf-_Af2YcM_YwVpZae2xHYkaZNYTyVMR9fyClp85WjO3Xk3mhcDPvunF8E4lsP6N9lajSlVcUUGpWswn1s0f-MJNuWevHhu70GKyupnCB2J2aZ8QC11iG4WM524bVu9n8OZvRfq4FkZuYA8Fdz9DDactbx4yfto7q3IE%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbWqSLnHgXMFnNoypwoPjY60xXSxu925AnZz8I2-5pLdpoJloKSAFF6d1gIpWS1oL3Qq5HfUIL5XFgaOLnbF3zQKuksi40Zgu61SsDkdEUe4K0DyNrayW6TAZzhZNnIEhDhAeEjb_ojP-Fggu0D22mH060XMWFrBY9QjqS7-frWhvs727_SWpDxDx0mBmv2i3Nv0l6mwCzRtSVOF88bqgUo7spZcU1EYUj3BuGkF3V1nAmKoOjozt8DBog5NLU8RcDdXh0mHI1FyFpaFsOYFYTmgucrBl4RUr8qJBjglcqAfdl9FtSOSxTal8yqNoBRWe813eaZKqzZOL_rssL7-w_hfnakBEpIIQraqyYd88apGk%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7288932b41a34254b53893c555f3cd4a&_e=lrFlrNA4Uf3Jen-IbYJ4gPg6HGaFn3SM3b398ZJxYuRMixQSkXwSf5To1oR-DgnbWqSLnHgXMFnNoypwoPjY60xXSxu925AnZz8I2-5pLdpoJloKSAFF6d1gIpWS1oL3Qq5HfUIL5XFgaOLnbF3zQKuksi40Zgu61SsDkdEUe4K0DyNrayW6TAZzhZNnIEhDhAeEjb_ojP-Fggu0D22mH060XMWFrBY9QjqS7-frWhvs727_SWpDxDx0mBmv2i3Nv0l6mwCzRtSVOF88bqgUo4KA5ZipLWzzd2yWq65RsQLOb86mLLIn01Khx5vVxEZ8rsgiitPPrgLAVpDvuNzx1JaKVO60wUh5eqTagsToYW2R9MmV8963KL2ZaAiU9hh0_reNyu3vk9NeAlbZN0O3fo4X1y5JGsVKFH_rnu8y_QA%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. subject: This Labor Day
body:
On this Labor Day, it is with great pride that I honor the American labor movement | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/this-labor-day?e=3818d77efc)

|
---
|
# Happy Labor Day!

Today I was proud to march in the Fountain Valley Labor Day Parade to honor the American labor movement and the people who have contributed to one of the largest labor forces. I also had the privilege to support and to celebrate with local Unions of the Pikes Peak Region in their Labor Day Festival. These are reminders of the work and organization that trade unionists made to recognize the importance of labor and how it was the backbone of what our country was built on.

---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| According to the Economic Policy Institute, from 1978-2022 top executives' compensation has skyrocketed up 1,209% compared to only 15.3% for typical workers' compensation. This has led to the diminishing middle class and an unsustainable economy for a majority of American residents. That's why when I'm in Congress I will not stop until we can build an opportunity economy where everyone has the ability to not only get by but to excel.
* Support the Pro Act in Congress - This would amend previous labor laws to restore the right of workers to freely organize and form a union
* Support Public Sector Unions - Government and public job unions can help employees and their families fight for better pay and benefits while increasing quality of public services
* Promote Employee Ownerships - Proven benefits for this are higher wages and net worth, better benefits and reducing outsourcing with higher productivity and faster growth
* Expand Workers' Rights - Work at a local, state and federal level to have paid leave, paid sick days for all workers and increase protections in education and healthcare

But I can't do it without your help! [Join me ](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=90d395559c&e=3818d77efc)in rebuilding our working and middle class and creating opportunities for all Coloradans and Americans. Together we can help protect our future for the next generation and create a working economy that we can all thrive in.
---
[Donate Now](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=e8578c04f9&e=3818d77efc)
|
Thank you for your unwavering support.
River Gassen

subject: How I spent Labor Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Eleni Kounalakis for Governor 2026
body:
Eleni Kounalakis for Governor Logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP01/1/62802/images/ekg-logomark-min.png]

Peter, it’s Eleni.

I know that Labor Day is one of our nation’s most important holidays, and that’s why I spent my Labor Day crisscrossing the Bay, kicking off fundraising and voter mobilization efforts for the Ironworkers of Local 378, who built the Golden Gate Bridge, and the North Bay Labor Council and their more than 70,000 members.

Eleni with a hotel worker [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP01/1/62802/images/unnamed.jpg]

To finish things off, I rushed back to San Francisco and marched alongside hotel workers in Union Square who were protesting for fair wages, so they could afford to live in the city they love.

Everywhere I went, workers told me one thing: When we fight, we win.

Whether they were on the picket line or in the union hall, each worker I had the privilege to speak with knew that the path to better wages, stronger labor protections and the union way of life starts with putting Kamala Harris in the White House this November.

Donald Trump and his Project 2025 Agenda, however, won’t stop until they turn every state into a right to work state, make organizing a union nearly impossible and privatize tens of thousands of well-paying, public sector union jobs.

In Donald Trump’s America, unions will be dismantled piece by piece. In Kamala Harris’s America, unions will be a key part of the American economy and way of life.

That’s why I’m so proud to be supporting the Harris-Walz ticket this Labor Day, and it’s why I’m asking You to join me today: because the ONLY way we’ll be able to stand up to the anti-union, MAGA Right is if we stand together in solidarity.

Please, consider chipping in $20 (or more if you can afford it) directly to the Harris-Walz campaign. With only 64 days to go until the election, let’s make sure Vice President Harris and Governor Walz have all the resources they need to win BIG against Donald Trump and JD Vance this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/etk-harris]

DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/etk-harris]

Thank you!

- Eleni Kounalakis

## Half a Million Israelis Protest in Streets
[Half a million protesters](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQQNGvgW6QGRvzKFy8hm7TpkSzeAyODF55nCX5-yhJm_5IV7qvt-VGMcVze6GDXQ15obXGJy8TaECzmNa7wIysW3b9iIMe-1HpdneWphCMQW_NNBoO3Pu7V2bF-8hTb-9tdKjQqEnpXik72G7QgzaauEf-h0i2MYp9rLl0bzmedeeQPvOTS7fmo01ur_Uhjf7f4NzgfF1XV-PBkkOUQpy-VYPzQSIs8Ci5slSgtWQR-CUQTwgpZw85wFYiB6Bz4wIUKhfY6SAB_uD1vbKAhT1LpY2lwbktzj-umFIUOzZGbQfFn2Rb_7z0dPgVAAD__z_ubNk) took to the streets of Tel Aviv and across Israel Sunday night, demanding a cease-fire agreement and the release of the remaining hostages held by Hamas. The demonstration followed the recovery of six hostages' bodies from Gaza tunnels by the Israel Defense Forces.Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu [apologized to the hostages' families](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOnDAQQL_GdEb2jDFs4SJShJRi06ZEs3iAiQxeYR-r-_vTXn31K97T-3ef7iRJjvUv7Rzqkieaq1w83TRqcJNrYliYgbHhYHvosLe9wWYLFum2-Bh7ggdRHOyw2AEfDq13RBEaCWDAmZtBa4zvfNthhw6JLfAAQF45w1FqPtv_WY668ZI-88VnO-e9SWGr9VkU_lIwKhjpMR_8Ku2a31jB-OeofB5UJR-UFIxJLtYfz0iVi4JRykmc9EY7Fb3lUmnlomemwnqRk_UuMSbWTKW-DThKVPjbWkTre8TmDPH5kpSk-F45s-4k6bus_rjpCvAVAAD__3Wraa0), saying, "We were close, but we did not succeed."President Joe Biden confirmed that negotiations for a cease-fire and hostage release are ongoing, with U.S. coordination involving Qatar and Egypt.On Monday, Hamas released a propaganda video showing [Eden Yerushalmi](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQQNGvMZ2RmcGwW7h4Dd2-NiWaxQNMZDCyvZD9-yip01_pSufjMT5IguzLf9rYlTmONBU5ebxr1NCObeXdzAyMFbumB4t90xusVmefMKF99h0yINoW7Q1v4O9sLM2TxUocGGjN3WBjTGe72qLFFokb4BsAdao17KXEVH9G2cvKc3jHk1M9xa0Kbi3lyAr_KRgUDNd11UU2znGWnIjDT6VgCHLyM8Rl5L2kt4JhpY2yThyYMmd9pHjQQrsnfYrnqPMaL9kXzV88vQp7vcZcaGHNnnf95vTKK4VNFAxVcv64JATJXa9as2wkv9-q_El1OvgOAAD__7PKbpo), who was kidnapped on Oct. 7. Her body was among those recovered and buried on Sunday.
## U.S. Seizes Maduro's Luxury Jet

body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkt99mcoghtc3uqshuuobjclqqisb4itp6f6pv70_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjm4p76c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi7ltg0p9vp75fuj2nh9m64bqn505kjo834orhho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjm4p76c9h2bs) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **

That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. | | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.” when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. | | | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,” along with the companion map today: Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic” and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: You can learn from Rome’s history
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuehhcl34quhs3mngn7gf23q7qjmn1qh8dtqt1c0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjmco74cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zreu7vo645bpumu3t0e1ovccejnnubuc1amo53mg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjmco74cth2bs) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjsph1phdojb9a7i0mfmmsg77a6hmdf96fcutuqo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjmco74cth2bs)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkesrvnratmich0m19sa1o8a02khaof6e9u7k6po_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cpjmco74cth2bs)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

## New Law Requires Food Allergy Posters in Restaurants
As of Sept. 1, restaurants in Texas must display [food allergy awareness posters](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGngQ4LBoyvC4rbuMu2W1qDGSdIxGSB2Mnbr-J6--_Xkc73Zb5gTHG7fuGdXHutecalxZ3mUWgBZjY8OC_DqDg5NUCvrVW95jdn_TooMHaUA6In9OjBrDiEUa5grOHRgQQjR6mV7K3uO_uvV-CXXoNSg1aeGUkhtly6dqNGL6xreuedSrfkO0_u1tqjMv2fwcRgOo6j2zElei-0tYLpoxhMGx2VwXT2DKY15yA-rFzf4pFro1LFlg9R6OcZCwURN3FiUag2fBbc2ifkxYXHEVOK1Q7MyOsd47nB29-_7A5-AwAA__9VBGfr) to apply for or renew their certifications. The new state law was passed in response to the death of Sergio Alexander Lopez of McAllen, who suffered a [fatal allergic reaction](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuhDAURL_GdF75vVC4SEO3aVOiC76AJWOv7Jt9_H201Kln5mh0fm7TDWKKefuGAz291jLBQvGB08A1V2YyXfCzCIPs0Mursto5aXW3eyuW3hjdOymtdlIFB0HPqNfBziZo20WvhDJiEFoK67S9uN5KNS9WKymvWs7MCAyRSr3QjoQvaGt6lwfWy1KOLvmd6N6Y_mJqZGrcSwkpZvyETI0fNlOj6Jkazy0_IAcgbBxSwrq9OTyhYsbW-L00wtp4zLxiI_itkKnxtaRUnjFvnCpsceEBgXZeVn4sH8jZjgEzMTV21Yf7M6YUm7syI7YDYjqf0v_eHl79BQAA__9hVXGS) in 2014 despite repeatedly asking restaurant staff about the safety of his meal. After [working for years](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAUBNCvwR0WXMDYBcVr3OW1W1o4XBK0BLJAQvL3q7jeeuZIo_k6bScbYkiX__aGpr183uy5hSduCxUU5CYHZ3bmFj6g4RqUmCauxHA1fBZearbo3TOmhWa757MUSi7O-Xm2QzDAQLKFCc7UJNQ4zYrDflYCONeC70QydKHlMrYrNnzZ6uM7P7GM53wborm2dq9E_COwElh77-P3y6ZPSGBN2CuB9WAEVp-zozZGLJc3vefasFSacqcFfx6hoKMh0aNMC9ZmH8Wm9oFDMe7eQ4yhTppIdrnZEI8B7e87ngZ-AwAA__-iLGNO) to get the state to require restaurants to display warnings about food allergies, Lopez's mother, Belinda Vaca, says she wants the federal government to pass a similar law.
## "Innovation" Jail To Open In Bartlett
A state jail in Bartlett that was shut down seven years ago is reopening as the state's [first "Innovation" Unit](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLuOpDAURL_GZEZ-YNwEDjYh6003RH7RXK2xkX0Huv9-xMSTVFKl0tH591yeFhLk11-7R4PvtSzWI5xxmaikYliGLhjHwsS7aLgWSo4jV7LbjAvM89U5-dCDdiqMnikZ9KQHJkb98B0YwcTAJiY5U6NU_fhQXDivpOBcS-7IwGIALLXHLWJ827amTzlj7X3Zu2Q2xKMR-YeImYj5uq7-_4XvuyRivr-JmNl0hyBiPiq0kulqPSTAD62xHDFDflFnK6aISFeoDSnkXE6LUDL9yoC0ocVIy7rGeq9b9CUH6jebfWwU8m4xNuoBP0TMXTXhuCAlaKMmA3vtFtIPL_5u7zTiOwAA__8xNHON), aiming at equipping inmates with workforce skills and certifications. # Voter Guide for the Massachusetts U.S. Senate primary election this Tuesday

We have gotten many requests to do a voter guide for the U.S. Senate Republican Primary this Tuesday, Sept. 3. Apparently, there is a lot of confusion as to where the three candidates stand on pro-family issues and general Republican issues.

The three candidates are Robert Antonellis, Ian Cain, and John Deaton.The winner will face far-left Sen. Elizabeth Warren in the November General Election. John Deaton has spent an enormous amount of money already on mailings and commercials. But he mostly discusses the border problem and inflation, which the three candidates basically agree on, though with some policy differences.

Here is an assessment of the candidates from a pro-family and general Republican perspective. It’s a window to how they would vote in the US Senate if elected.

Robert Antonellis
_Pro-family issues:_ From everything we’ve seen, Antonellis is a full-spectrum solid pro-family candidate, and he is not afraid to say so. He even attended a School Committee meeting in Sutton, MA, to support parents who were outraged over the transgender agenda in their local high school.

_Republican issues:_ Antonellis is strongly pro-Trump and often wears a red Trump MAGA hat to events and speaking engagements. He believes that Republicans should stand strong on so-called culture-war issues.

Ian Cain
_Pro-family issues:_ Cain describes himself as “openly gay.” He says he is “pro-choice” though agrees with the Dobbs ruling because he believes abortion should be left up to the states.

_Republican issues:_ Cain recently said he will not vote for President Trump. Cain only registered as a Republican this year. According to press reports, he endorsed Democrats Healey for Governor and Wu for Mayor of Boston, and donated to far-left Mass. AG Andrea Campbell and other high-profile Democrats. Cain includes a rather crude slogan in his emails: _“If elected, my promise is simple. I will get shit done.”_

John Deaton
_Pro-family issues:_ Deaton has said that supports same-sex ‘marriage’ and told the press, _“Let me be crystal clear: I am pro-choice.”_ He opposes the Dobbs ruling overturning Roe v Wade.

_Republican issues:_ Deaton has been very hostile toward President Trump and says he will not vote for him. He tweeted to Donald Trump in 2020, _“You actually may be the worst human being in the U.S.”_ and _“You have without question the mind of a 4 year old.”_ He also has a low opinion of Trump supporters. Just before the 2020 election he tweeted to Trump, _“... anyone that believes the nonsense and BS that you are shoveling now is to be judged as a complete and utter moron.”_ He moved to Massachusetts from Rhode Island in January.

It would certainly appear that Robert Antonellis is the best pro-family candidate to vote for this Tuesday.

# A Call to Action for America's Future
---
| Today is Election Day.
I am asking for your vote in the Republican Primary.
The United States is at a crossroads, facing unprecedented challenges that threaten our security, prosperity, and global standing. From the crisis at our southern border to the economic pain of inflation, our nation is struggling under the weight of ineffective policies and Washington's inaction.
Here at home, the consequences of our failures are evident. In Massachusetts, we see the strain on our state budget as we struggle to cope with the influx of illegal migrants. Essential programs for American citizens are being underfunded, and our security is at risk. Meanwhile, Washington continues to do what it does best: nothing.
But the solutions are clear. We need to secure our borders with a combination of physical and technological barriers, reinstate the proven Remain in Mexico policy, and streamline the legal immigration process to prioritize America's needs. Unfortunately my opponent in the Republican primary, John Deaton, supports an amnesty and open border policy that would only make the problem worse.
At the same time, we are facing a crisis of housing affordability, with families being priced out of communities and homeownership. To address this, we need to encourage public-private partnerships that can expand and grow communities in need. By building new housing and creating opportunities for affordable living, we can help more Americans achieve the dream of homeownership and secure the future for our families.
Central to all of these challenges is the need to support American families. Our future generations depend on the investments we make today. From childbirth to childcare, education to housing, we must make it easier for families to realize the American Dream and set up future generations for success. The basics of life—food, shelter, healthcare, and energy—should be affordable, accessible, and of the highest quality. To achieve this, we need legislation that makes childbirth free, reduces the cost of childcare, and takes a holistic approach to education, preparing our young people for the challenges and opportunities of the future.
By investing in America, we can unleash the full potential of our nation. We have the power to create a future where our borders are secure, our economy works for all Americans, our infrastructure is world-class, and our global standing is unmatched. The time for action is now. Let's come together to meet these challenges head-on, with the strength, resolve, and innovation that have always defined our nation.
Be sure to vote today, our future depends on it.

Our progressive elites have found a backdoor for their radical agendas

Our progressive elites have found a backdoor for their radical agendas when they are defeated at the ballot box. They can pressure businesses to go woke!

But I didn't enter this race because I knew I could buy my way to the Senate. I'm running because, like me, Floridians are fed up with his flimsy leadership and desperate thirst for power. We've had enough — and, friend that's why he's spending millions of dollars to beat me. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Trump did in Michigan...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1866%2E135344%2EqS9cHA)

Last week, Donald Trump spoke in Detroit at the National Guard Conference. It should have been an opportunity to bring people together, or offer a vision for our country and our role in the world.
Instead, he spent his time in Michigan airing personal grievances, painting a dark picture of our country and its people, and, (for some reason) talking about Missouri.
And where he did touch on our national security or our place in the world, it was a vision for an America in retreat, rather than the world’s leading democracy. He would let Putin do whatever he wanted in Ukraine and abandon our NATO allies in the face of Russian aggression.
This won’t be the last time we see Donald Trump here in Michigan — In fact, in a recent 9 day stretch, he made his 7th, 8th, and 9th visits to the state, with JD Vance also making his 4th trip to Michigan since becoming the vice presidential candidate. They won't be their last. Far from it.
Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
Trump’s visits could not be a more obvious sign that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.
For as good as the vibes have been lately, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. And political forecasters have said Michigan is a pure toss up.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
Because just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right back.

| Peter, I hope you and your family enjoyed your Labor Day weekend. On this weekend which celebrates the worker I couldn’t help but think about the thousands of New Jerseyans out of work. We’re facing record unemployment numbers. Our state is actually the sixth highest in unemployment in the country. Our average rate of unemployment is above the national average–and the national economy isn’t doing great either. New Jersey’s major industries of healthcare and banking are not healthy. Check out [this article](https://xtz223.keap-link014.com/v2/click/2a9a5345b64e773984c14d9f8bf7442a/eJyNkMtOwzAQRf_F67hOnRfKrqqqKkrpAsEahWSEXZKxZU8Iocq_YwrqCqSu59zXnBkBNkhVx0r2QZ9SJixiDlptNSBtDVLTXq4yS9fJOmK9xre9M6Nl5flP8RW4qPLsLmI0WwjI48NmW1fH_fOhOtaBtI0LGbf5FIm8-uzuN9WBLcu_xjBo2r0Hb89KciN8L-p0WEVPrg-8IrK-FGKaphUaR-oEzsO8as0gPBk3C4TJi5fRawTvhYxlKuJcyEzgiY8Ig-3NPIQA7hoCnpPiSr8q8MQ1clLAsSFtUBSpjNMsWcdxIUKxxlrA7verNcw_9ZYvMciAOw==) if you don’t believe me. As our state economy hangs in the balance, is there anything being done? Of course not. Phil Murphy [rolled out](https://xtz223.keap-link014.com/v2/click/c0a3d045e92b889d15163fefb038c0e9/eJyNUEuLwkAM_i85l047fQi9iYiUdj0su2cZbNDZrekwjXZd6X83PvCk4CGB8L34cgJGMsRlAwX88b_WCQTgcW2dReJZR2zWV1RnaZzEAbSWfhe-2zsoTk_FD8JVledRAHx0KJSvz-msKpeLVV0uK2E64yXjPZ9Joh8-849pWcM4vjTGneX5Qbx7KNjv8dKosdKKv30r_C2z6wulhmEI6SfcdAclg546rwiH_rayXEc6VcY5L2CjLleU6diE_ZZ3reQIhNTcn1Th8ZY2ngHZsW7b) a new program to make it easier to get unemployment insurance, but that’s about it. And it doesn’t even address the heart of the problem. So basically, we’re subsidizing not working instead of doing the things that actually allow the economy and job growth to happen. If that’s not lunacy... **Government overreach is killing small businesses and jobs all across our state.** As I’ve written to you previously, our state budget is the highest it’s ever been. Our spending is out of control. And so are the draconian policies the Left is pushing on our state. The Left is stifling our economy and destroying our freedoms. It cannot continue.

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Why I got into public service
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Upset The Setup PAC
body:
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

clean_body: Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter. = If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: = = = = = = I am not going to let anyone make me forget where I came from or why I got into public service in the first place. body:
Lyerly Backs Madison Values | | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASESeptember 3, 2024
---
| **Extreme Democrat Kristin Lyerly Bringing Madison Radical to Green Bay**
De Pere, WI – Businessman and common-sense Conservative Tony Wied’s campaign released the following statement on news that extreme Democrat Kristin Lyerly is [bringing radical liberal](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=871cc6acce&e=4c76b0e36b) Mark Pocan to campaign in Green Bay today.
---
| “The last thing WI-08 voters want is the insane agenda of Mark Pocan and his Madison values in this district,” said Wied Campaign Manager Aidan Strongreen. “Kristin Lyerly campaigning with a radical like Pocan, who has called to [defund the police](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=ed423a7beb&e=4c76b0e36b) and [abolish ICE](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=bdbbaf7a22&e=4c76b0e36b), shows she’s a far-left Democrat who is completely out of step with Northeast Wisconsin voters.”
Multiple experts have [downplayed Lyerly’s chances of winning the seat](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=192d9a0db5&e=4c76b0e36b) due to her extreme positions, including her sole focus on allowing abortion up until the moment of birth.
“I don’t know that it plays well given the conservative Catholic constituency here,” explained Michael Kraft, professor emeritus at UW-Green Bay.
And election expert Kyle Kondik said this about the race, “It was about a 15-point margin for Donald Trump. That is redder than any other district Democrats hold across the country...And that’s why I think that the Republicans are still pretty strong favorites to hold this seat.”
Read more about Tony’s campaign at [https://tonywiedforcongress.com](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=ed57869587&e=4c76b0e36b).

I wanted to take a moment to explain why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in the first place. But before I do...
#

Peter — as we begin our final, official quarterly FEC deadline of the campaign, I wanted to take a moment to explain why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in the first place.
But before I do, [**I was hoping you could chip in to help us start this important month off on the right foot.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240903-1-160&t=1&akid=3006%2E734936%2EpUxVb5) We’ve set our highest goals of the entire campaign, and it is absolutely critical that we hit them.
If you understand how important this is and are ready to chip in, you can use this link to make that contribution: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruben-em-sept24**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240903-1-160&t=2&akid=3006%2E734936%2EpUxVb5)
For me, here’s what this decision came down to:
My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire Iraq war. But the fight didn’t end there.
Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.
But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve and to their families.
I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.
After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act in 2022 to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.
Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” He’s insulted Medal of Honor recipients, and he disrespected Arlington National Cemetery last week.
He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.
They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, I am going to do everything I can to defeat them.
But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter.
And today, I need your help.
[**Please, chip in $5 to my campaign. We’ve started September off far too slowly, and if we’re going to raise what we need to hit our goals for this official FEC deadline, we need to get back on track.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240903-1-160&t=3&akid=3006%2E734936%2EpUxVb5)

# Join Us in Shaping the Future of College Park
Dear Neighbor, Welcome to United College Park (UCP), where we believe in the power of community to shape a brighter future for College Park. Our mission is to empower residents like you to take an active role in the governance of our community, ensuring transparency, accountability, and inclusivity. At UCP, we’re dedicated to addressing the issues that matter most to our community. Here are some of the initiatives we are actively working on:
* **Supporting Our Youth and Protecting Community Spaces:** We are working to preserve the rock climbing wall at the Tracy Wyatt Recreational Center and the Bill Evans baseball field, ensuring our youth have safe spaces and access to positive opportunities for growth.
* **Standing Against Environmental Racism:** We oppose the development of a lithium battery storage facility in our area due to pollution concerns and the risk of fires that our fire department lacks the resources to extinguish.

In addition to these specific efforts, UCP focuses on several broader initiatives to strengthen our community:
* **Voter Education:** We aim to educate College Park residents about their voting rights and the importance of holding elected officials accountable.
* **Cultivating Leadership:** We are committed to identifying and supporting candidates who reflect the values and needs of our community.
* **Advocating for Change:** We work to address key community issues by mobilizing advocacy efforts to improve public services and local infrastructure.

**Our Community, Our Voice** United College Park is for everyone who cares about the future of our community. You don't need to support any particular initiative, such as a recall, to be part of our movement. What matters most is that you share our commitment to making College Park a better place for all, and together we can ensure every voice is heard, and every concern is addressed. You’ll notice that UCP will begin sharing more community information in the coming weeks. We believe it’s essential for everyone to stay informed about what’s happening in our neighborhood. By sharing timely updates, news, and events, we hope to keep everyone connected and aware of the issues and opportunities that affect us all. We invite you to share this email with other concerned citizens in our community. Encourage them to learn more about our efforts and sign up for our mailing list at [UnitedCollegePark.com](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMxNDYzMDI0NjU5NjYyODIzLFwiclwiOjEzMTQ2MzAyNDkzNjQ4NjQzN30iLCJzIjoiNTU2YzQ4NDIwNzk5N2Y1MyJ9). Together, we can bring change and unity to our community. Thank you for your support. Let’s continue to build the city we deserve, United College Park

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70462?refcode=em20240903-7539&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=7539%2E614464%2EBSv0Na ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF and our
right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee access to
IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion

name: Vikram for NH
subject: Make the Economy Great Again!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vikram4NH | P
body:
Read Vikram's Latest Op-Ed
| | | |
---
---
---
WHEN I entered the race to represent the Second District in Congress, I condemned Washington, D.C. dysfunction and said I was running to fix the mess. D.C. is a mess because it is filled with career politicians and lifelong bureaucrats, who are disconnected from the lives of everyday Americans.
Nowhere is the mess more obvious than with the economy. A bunch of people who have spent their careers in the Beltway bubble collecting government paychecks, recklessly borrowed, printed, and spent too much, generating budget-busting prices on everything from groceries to heating oil. So-called experts and Washington elites broke the economy and hard-working families are feeling the pain. Our 401k's are rapidly turning into 301k's, the global markets are realizing our economy has been driven by unsustainable debt-fueled government spending, and proposed policies are now overtly socialist.
It didn't have to be this way. Consider that when President Donald Trump left the White House in January 2021, inflation was 1.4%. Less than two years after Democrats took the White House and opened the spending spigot, inflation hit 9%. Many of us feel like we're going backward, and for good reason -- because we are. American incomes (on average) haven't kept up with the cost of living. Ironically, the Democrat solution to inflation caused by too much government spending is ... more spending. The Inflation Reduction Act, (really an Inflation Production Act) which Kamala Harris enabled with a tie-breaking vote, kicked off a green-energy spendathon. Goldman Sachs analysts recently estimated that her vote would cost taxpayers $1.2 trillion. Or think about the fact that the Biden-Harris administration has written off more than $170 billion of student debt, which divides out to about $700 per taxpayer!
And how do they pay for all of this? Through inflation. Think of it as a hangover tax, the result of spending like drunken sailors, and one that is squeezing our budgets while helping the rich. And it's leaving our kids and grandkids a mountain of debt. Meanwhile, Washington insiders and elites tell us the economy is great. What they really mean is that it's great for them. (Some of the wealthiest ZIP codes in the United States are in the D.C. area.)
Career politicians and bureaucrats no longer associate with, understand, or represent hard working American families. How could they? They live in a cocoon, hidden from the pressures of strained budgets and economic cycles. They don't understand the problems we face; worse, they think we are the problem. To lower prices and improve affordability, we need leaders with real world experience and common sense, not lifelong politicians or career bureaucrats. We need to embrace capitalism and run as fast as possible away from socialism. And in this regard the contrast between the Republican and Democrat tickets is noteworthy. The Trump-Vance team has decades of experience in the private sector, while the Harris-Walz team has a combined total of zero years of business experience. In fact, a 2022 study found that the majority of Biden-Harris administration officials who were responsible for economic policy had no business experience at all. Is it any surprise that Trump policies resulted in widespread and inclusive growth that helped almost everyone, while Biden's have only helped a few?
The 2024 election offers Americans a clear choice: career politicians who live in a political bubble or businessmen who understand how the economy works. Capitalism or socialism. An economy that works for all or one that just works for a few.
Unusually, there are two actual administrations to compare, complete with implemented policies and realized results.
President Trump cut taxes and regulations, encouraged American energy production, and addressed the emerging threats from China. He made NATO countries pay their bills, ushered in the Abraham Accords, which were bringing peace to the Middle East, and decreased American military engagement abroad. The result? An economic boom that led to income gains for most segments of society. The American Dream was alive and well, with equal opportunity for all.
The Harris-Biden policies, on the other hand, were hostile to fossil fuels, mandated diversity training in the government and military, and continued a long stream of handouts and giveaways. Further, Harris now wants to set price controls, a sure-fire way to generate shortages and higher prices. The result? Budget-busting inflation that hurts everyone. We are watching the American Dream slip away as housing, education, and food are increasingly unaffordable.
Like many, I vote based on how policies will impact the economy, and the choice is clear. To lower prices, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance. To have an economy that works for everyone, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance. And ultimately, to protect our society from socialism and all its ills, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance.
We cannot afford another Democrat administration. It will bankrupt working families and quite possibly America, turn the American Dream into a nightmare, and replace equal opportunity with elite-determined outcomes.
It's time to make the economy great again.
Vikram Mansharamani of Lincoln is a candidate for Congress in the Second Congressional District.

clean_body: Read Vikram's Latest Op-Ed | | | | WHEN I entered the race to represent the Second District in Congress, I condemned Washington, D.C. dysfunction and said I was running to fix the mess. D.C. is a mess because it is filled with career politicians and lifelong bureaucrats, who are disconnected from the lives of everyday Americans. Nowhere is the mess more obvious than with the economy. A bunch of people who have spent their careers in the Beltway bubble collecting government paychecks, recklessly borrowed, printed, and spent too much, generating budget-busting prices on everything from groceries to heating oil. So-called experts and Washington elites broke the economy and hard-working families are feeling the pain. Our 401k's are rapidly turning into 301k's, the global markets are realizing our economy has been driven by unsustainable debt-fueled government spending, and proposed policies are now overtly socialist. It didn't have to be this way. Consider that when President Donald Trump left the White House in January 2021, inflation was 1.4%. Less than two years after Democrats took the White House and opened the spending spigot, inflation hit 9%. Many of us feel like we're going backward, and for good reason -- because we are. American incomes (on average) haven't kept up with the cost of living. Ironically, the Democrat solution to inflation caused by too much government spending is ... more spending. The Inflation Reduction Act, (really an Inflation Production Act) which Kamala Harris enabled with a tie-breaking vote, kicked off a green-energy spendathon. Goldman Sachs analysts recently estimated that her vote would cost taxpayers $1.2 trillion. Or think about the fact that the Biden-Harris administration has written off more than $170 billion of student debt, which divides out to about $700 per taxpayer! And how do they pay for all of this? Through inflation. Think of it as a hangover tax, the result of spending like drunken sailors, and one that is squeezing our budgets while helping the rich. And it's leaving our kids and grandkids a mountain of debt. Meanwhile, Washington insiders and elites tell us the economy is great. What they really mean is that it's great for them. (Some of the wealthiest ZIP codes in the United States are in the D.C. area.) Career politicians and bureaucrats no longer associate with, understand, or represent hard working American families. How could they? They live in a cocoon, hidden from the pressures of strained budgets and economic cycles. They don't understand the problems we face; worse, they think we are the problem. To lower prices and improve affordability, we need leaders with real world experience and common sense, not lifelong politicians or career bureaucrats. We need to embrace capitalism and run as fast as possible away from socialism. And in this regard the contrast between the Republican and Democrat tickets is noteworthy. The Trump-Vance team has decades of experience in the private sector, while the Harris-Walz team has a combined total of zero years of business experience. In fact, a 2022 study found that the majority of Biden-Harris administration officials who were responsible for economic policy had no business experience at all. Is it any surprise that Trump policies resulted in widespread and inclusive growth that helped almost everyone, while Biden's have only helped a few? The 2024 election offers Americans a clear choice: career politicians who live in a political bubble or businessmen who understand how the economy works. Capitalism or socialism. An economy that works for all or one that just works for a few. Unusually, there are two actual administrations to compare, complete with implemented policies and realized results. President Trump cut taxes and regulations, encouraged American energy production, and addressed the emerging threats from China. He made NATO countries pay their bills, ushered in the Abraham Accords, which were bringing peace to the Middle East, and decreased American military engagement abroad. The result? An economic boom that led to income gains for most segments of society. The American Dream was alive and well, with equal opportunity for all. The Harris-Biden policies, on the other hand, were hostile to fossil fuels, mandated diversity training in the government and military, and continued a long stream of handouts and giveaways. Further, Harris now wants to set price controls, a sure-fire way to generate shortages and higher prices. The result? Budget-busting inflation that hurts everyone. We are watching the American Dream slip away as housing, education, and food are increasingly unaffordable. Like many, I vote based on how policies will impact the economy, and the choice is clear. To lower prices, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance. To have an economy that works for everyone, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance. And ultimately, to protect our society from socialism and all its ills, I'm going to vote Trump-Vance. We cannot afford another Democrat administration. It will bankrupt working families and quite possibly America, turn the American Dream into a nightmare, and replace equal opportunity with elite-determined outcomes. It's time to make the economy great again. Vikram Mansharamani of Lincoln is a candidate for Congress in the Second Congressional District. | | Vikram, sign me up! The geographer who blew the whistle on DeSantis' failed plans to turn Florida's state parks into golf courses has been fired by the state, [the Palm Beach Post reported](https://substack.com/redirect/f1df7c1d-bf4b-4a03-b1c8-8f46eea2a672?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
News about the state's plans were met with [fierce opposition](https://substack.com/redirect/bf9ae129-30d3-4fcf-94aa-afa158fe9037?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the last two weeks, with DeSantis ultimately backing down, but not before[ DeSantis lied ](https://substack.com/redirect/82a49620-226a-4fac-aee5-09471e7219cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)about the plans and his office's role in coming up with the scheme.
James Gaddis, a 41-year-old geographer with the Florida Department of Environmental Protection, [leaked the information ](https://substack.com/redirect/35c206b8-526f-4f69-9220-036b270c4876?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after he was personally tasked with mapping out the plans.
The state fired him for that -- and he's now at the epicenter of the DeSantis revenge machine.
I've been in his position, as [have many others](https://substack.com/redirect/632c279d-63cb-4e9c-a945-aaccfcc65c62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He's going to need -- and he rightfully deserves -- our help.
[Click here](https://substack.com/redirect/35c206b8-526f-4f69-9220-036b270c4876?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to support my fellow Florida whistleblower and geographer by donating to his GoFundMe.

body:
Let's push Rob Across the Goal Line | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ac73af4c9496/huge-labor-day-weekend?e=131e83a3c2)
---
| Dear friend,
Rob and the rest of the team would like to wish you a very happy Labor Day. We hope you enjoyed some cookouts with your family and thank you to everyone who still had to go to work to keep NEPA and the rest of the country going!
---
|
---
[](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=658b892625&e=131e83a3c2)
|
College is starting up and the Rob for PA team is looking for ambitious, talented young people who want real-world experience on the campaign trail. If you or someone you know would like to join a winning campaign, email our Deputy Campaign Manager, Peter, at [Peter@RobForPA.com](mailto:peter@robforpa.com?subject=Intern%20for%20Team%20Rob&body=) or submit an application via the link above.
---
|
---
| Rob was ALL OVER PA-08 last week. We had events in Wilkes-Barre Township, Stroudsburg, Scranton, and Dallas. Rob connected with voters across the district and listened to the concerns of farmers, union workers, and retired folks in our community.
---
|
---
| The Chair of the House Committee on Agriculture, Congressman G.T. Thompson, joined Rob for a round table on agriculture and farming, on Friday. Rob, G.T., and State Senator Lisa Baker headlined the round table and heard all the issues facing farmers in NEPA.
---
|
---
| Above, you can see an actual picture of Matt Cartwright, in his patented election year flannel, **REFUSING** to debate Rob until the eleventh hour, after thousands of votes have already been cast. Join us in pressuring this chicken to take accountability for his far-left record.
---
|
---
| Team Rob was out and about all week! The Team was knocking on doors, making phone calls, and putting out yard signs to make sure Rob **WINS** this November.
---
|
---
[](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=27017b2765&e=131e83a3c2)
| Congratulations to Judy Ahrens on being named our Volunteer of the Week! Thank you for everything you do, especially all your hard work on the phones to bring people together for Rob.
---
|
---
[](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=afc1e25e3d&e=131e83a3c2)
| We have yard signs! [**Click here**](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=b5ca794f71&e=131e83a3c2) to request a yard sign today.
---
|
---

You can donate online. Please give any amount you are able, every penny counts! Click the logo below to donate now!

| It may seem like Texas is one of few states that is holding the line on vaccine choice. But, the reality is that patients across the state are still suffering from egregious and unethical **discriminatory practices** by healthcare providers. We have been collecting stories from supporters in our “Daily Dose of Discrimination,” three of which can be seen below. Unfortunately, **these shocking incidents are completely legal** in the Lone Star State! Despite advocating strongly for changes to current statute so that doctors would be prohibited from denying care based on vaccination status, **lawmakers ultimately failed** to act in the 88th Legislative Session to protect patients. TFVC remains dedicated to ending this type of discrimination and defending patients’ and parents’ rights, so heading into the 89th Session, we have **prioritized protective legislation**. While the Session does not start until January 2025, TFVC has already started meeting with Texas electeds to get feedback and commitments on our legislative agenda.
**It’s beyond time for Texas to truly lead on matters of medical liberty!**

Meet up with Freedom Virginia advocates and Delegate Kannan Srinivasan (HD 26) under the pavilion at Meadow Glen Park. With support from grassroots donors like you, we were out-raising Boebert – and Adam had already driven another 24,000 miles to listen to voters. It looked like we were heading for a win... so Lauren Boebert ran off scared. But with Boebert now out of the race, things are going to be harder. We’ve got a new Republican opponent who is trying to hide his extremism, and the Republican Super PACs are already circling to try to stop us from winning. This is a must-win House seat this November. Ours was the closest race in the entire country in 2022. But if Adam is going to win this critical House seat and replace Lauren Boebert in Congress, we’re counting on grassroots donors like you to give now: = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Our entire family has been so humbled by the support from people like you. We’re so grateful that you’re on this journey with us. From the bottom of our hearts: Thank you. Katy ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. Hi Peter, it’s George.

Saturday at midnight was our end-of-month deadline, and I’ll just say this, Peter: I am constantly humbled by your generosity.

As always, you banded together to back my campaign — working as a team to ensure our fundraising goal was reached. We are now another step closer to the leadership NY-16 deserves.

Your surge of grassroots support has allowed us to hit the ground running in these final 63 days ahead of the finish line. I can’t thank you enough, Peter.

Because of your generosity, I am able to continue delivering real results on issues that impact our communities most. When you elect me to Congress, I will keep fighting for working families and pushing to protect our rights — no matter what.

I am so grateful to have you by my side. Now, let’s stay focused!

Together, our momentum is unstoppable. Onwards to November.

With gratitude,

George

body:
Over the past few weeks, I've had the privilege of meeting so many of you across Southwest Virginia. From roundtables to marching in parades. | | | | |
---
| Dear Supporter,
Over the past few weeks, I’ve had the privilege of meeting so many of you across Southwest Virginia. From roundtables in Independence to marching in Labor Day parades, from union halls to farm stands, I've been everywhere, listening to your concerns and meeting new voters. Dear
Friend,

In the
annals of history, military triumphs and defeats have been
attributed to a host of factors-material resources, manpower,
pre-war strategies, and tactical doctrine all play a part in
determining the victors and the vanquished.

However,
as we delve deeper into the past, we uncover a truth that
surpasses conventional wisdom-a truth of extraordinary
significance.

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the
remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated
by the savior generals-visionary leaders displaying unparalleled
expertise.

Today,
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite
your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian
and Hoover Senior Fellow, Victor Davis Hanson, has authored a
groundbreaking eBook-Victory and the Savior Generals-a
captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional
leaders.

You can
secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link:
https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals

its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the
defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity,
contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into
seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict,
rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment
with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is
your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most
influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate
even in the present day.

body:
The American Dream is alive, my friends.
Just look:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]
This is a picture of my mom and three sisters watching me speak at the DNC.
My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary. I worked any job I could get to support the family. I slept on the floor, on the couch, on a roll-out mattress. I got into Harvard with no money and no connections. I fought in Iraq. And now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona.
I believed it when I was a kid, and I believe it now: Anything is possible in the United States of America.
But there is no denying that the American Dream feels out of reach for far too many.
Kari Lake won’t fix that, and Trump won’t either. They’ll divide us further, cut taxes for their billionaire friends, and leave an economy that works for them — not working families, not the middle class.
It is up to us to keep the American Dream alive — to defend it, to strengthen it. And the best way we can do that is by defeating Trump and Kari Lake.
So, I’m asking you to make a split donation to my campaign and Tim Kaine today. Whatever you can afford. No donation is too small in a campaign as close as this one, and these add up fast when everyone is chipping in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1867%2E135344%2EH9vkfA)

Stop. *Record scratch. Freeze frame.*
You may be wondering how this girl:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240903-2-fl&t=2&akid=1867%2E135344%2EH9vkfA)
Ended up here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240903-2-fl&t=3&akid=1867%2E135344%2EH9vkfA)
Serving my first of three tours in Iraq as a CIA analyst in Iraq, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting US forces and Iraqi civilians and plotting against the U.S.
It started on 9/11. One of the big moments that changed my life.
I was 24 years old, and I happened to be in New York City on my second day of grad school. By the time the dust had settled, I knew that I wanted to go into national security and protect my country.
Several months later, the CIA came to campus and my favorite professor encouraged me to hear what they had to say. Not wanting to disappoint him, I went. I applied, got the job, and after a lengthy background check, I started in Langley as an analyst.
It wasn’t long before I found myself in Iraq, my first of three deployments.
Going from the national security world to politics was a major culture shock. For 16 years, I didn’t talk publicly about my work—when I posted on Facebook that I was thinking about running for Congress, people asked me if I’d been hacked. One thing I definitely hadn’t done was ask people for money.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. When you're running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, you can't take anything for granted.

It has been a busy summer in Northwest Washington

| | It has been a busy summer in Northwest Washington!
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92082921/495941881/1596212816?refcode=2024-09-03-news&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=74ec09b8-156a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGVjMDliOC0xNTZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iwo8jcjMGAwe2NBOVuCGvvmiY7gtNXW382ODVDskqbk=)****Big changes are on the horizon for the Island Transit facility, thanks to a significant $14.96 million federal grant from the Federal Transit Authority (FTA).** This funding will help Island Transit acquire 12 hydrogen fuel cell buses and the necessary infrastructure to move toward our goal of a zero-emission fleet. $7.53 million was earmarked to engineer and construct a new transit center on South Whidbey and five new hybrid vans as part of the expansion at the Coupeville operating base. I am proud to have helped secure this funding for Island Transit as the ranking member of the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee. [READ SOUTH WHIDBEY RECORD ARTICLE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92082922/495941882/2050835810?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGVjMDliOC0xNTZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iwo8jcjMGAwe2NBOVuCGvvmiY7gtNXW382ODVDskqbk=&emci=3da19efa-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=74ec09b8-156a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9494239) **The Lynnwood Times joined me on one of our canvassing walks in Mukilteo to knock on doors and hear from voters about what matters to them.** We discussed a wide array of topics, including the billions of dollars invested in Washington state by the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the bipartisan FAA Reauthorization Bill, the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, and my work to fund both county drug task forces and provide job skills training for those recovering from addiction. [Read Lynnwood Times article](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92082925/495941883/-1366856309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGVjMDliOC0xNTZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iwo8jcjMGAwe2NBOVuCGvvmiY7gtNXW382ODVDskqbk=&emci=3da19efa-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=74ec09b8-156a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9494239) **I visited Edmonds College to see its recently unveiled "Innovation Lab," a one-of-a-kind college training facility that offers students real-world experience in aerospace**.
