clean_body: It has been a busy summer in Northwest Washington | | | | It has been a busy summer in Northwest Washington! changes are on the horizon for the Island Transit facility, thanks to a significant $14.96 million federal grant from the Federal Transit Authority (FTA). This funding will help Island Transit acquire 12 hydrogen fuel cell buses and the necessary infrastructure to move toward our goal of a zero-emission fleet. $7.53 million was earmarked to engineer and construct a new transit center on South Whidbey and five new hybrid vans as part of the expansion at the Coupeville operating base. I am proud to have helped secure this funding for Island Transit as the ranking member of the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee. The Lynnwood Times joined me on one of our canvassing walks in Mukilteo to knock on doors and hear from voters about what matters to them. We discussed a wide array of topics, including the billions of dollars invested in Washington state by the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the bipartisan FAA Reauthorization Bill, the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, and my work to fund both county drug task forces and provide job skills training for those recovering from addiction. I visited Edmonds College to see its recently unveiled "Innovation Lab," a one-of-a-kind college training facility that offers students real-world experience in aerospace. The program has been hugely successful, graduating about 300 students annually, with over 90% of tracked graduates securing jobs in manufacturing. The Innovation Lab does not just provide students with tangible skills but also builds our economy with a new generation of aerospace workers and helps Northwest Washington maintain its status as a leading aerospace hub. Finally, the Lummi Nation and other local tribes are supporting The PROTECT Act — new bipartisan legislation that I introduced to combat the opioid crisis. This act would empower Tribal courts to issue search warrants for social media accounts of suspected drug dealers and expand Tribal jurisdiction over drug trafficking crimes. I am grateful that I was able to spend time with these folks and others across Northwest Washington over the summer. The hardworking people in our communities are what make the 2nd District great. | | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---

name: Hillsdale College via Old Glory Today
subject: Their rise and fall
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8sFLd-1jVaAhybSJTsW3lA~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8sFLd-1jVaAhybSJTsW3lA~~/AARclAA~~~) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8sFLd-1jVaAhybSJTsW3lA~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8sFLd-1jVaAhybSJTsW3lA~~/AARclAA~~~)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
---

subject: Their rise and fall
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HKiBIbYpoTdCA9UGdKn0xw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoud-~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HKiBIbYpoTdCA9UGdKn0xw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoud-~~) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HKiBIbYpoTdCA9UGdKn0xw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoud-~~)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HKiBIbYpoTdCA9UGdKn0xw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoud-~~)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
---

# [Tell ABC to challenge Trump’s debate lies in real time, to his face](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61815f59-bb96-4f2c-b40e-4430de39c70b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[>>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18db5780-55c6-48a6-b2fb-d6b944e4f853/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Kamala Harris and Donald Trump are set to debate on September 10th, on ABC. And one thing is certain — Trump will tell lie after lie after lie. **[ABC must call out Trump's obvious lies in real time, during the debate, and to his face.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teaaa5fae-aac4-4ee4-a8a2-7c584726cb36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Not after, during post-debate analysis, when people are no longer watching.** ABC has top-notch juornalists, researchers and fact checkers, and together they have the ability to call BS nearly instantaneously. They routinely call out lies in real time during regular interviews, and they can and should do it here as well -- whether or not Trump likes it. **Let's have a real debate — one where facts matter. Not another useless one where the moderators sit there like mannequins, doing nothing to push back on obvious whoppers.** [**Add your name: Tell ABC to challenge out Trump's debate lies in real time.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcfac91ec-c306-4fe4-ad7c-716dd39618a3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: The 5 lies of Critical Race Theory
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow Conservative,

The anti-critical race theory movement
is gaining traction both ideologically and politically. And that
has progressives both outraged and panicked.

They'll do anything they can to stop
this movement. Their latest strategy is to distort the truth and
mislead the American people so that they can continue to push
their Marxist agenda. And they are using their friends in the
establishment media and Big Tech to do so.

But these lies are being unmasked and
exposed by The Heritage Foundation.

That's why I'm sending you this email
today.

I'm told that you are an American who
is concerned about the levels of indoctrination we've seen from
Critical Race Theory-and what that could mean for the future of
our country.

So, today, I want to send you a FREE
copy of The Heritage Foundation's latest eBook, The 5 Lies of
CRT.

Inside this important resource, you'll
not only learn the 5 lies Progressives have employed in their
campaign to push Critical Race Theory, but you'll also discover
that:

None of CRT's policy approaches
would help people of any race or national origin.

All of the biggest names pushing
CRT have affirmed that they are promoting Marxism.

The Left is using CRT to wage a
battle royal for the soul of America-and even the West itself.

You can get instant access to your FREE
eBook right now using this secure link:
https://secured.heritage.org/5lies-of-crt-ebook/

As the Left ramps up their campaign
through the power of the media and Big Tech, it is crucial that
we inform as many people as possible with the truth about what is
really going on.

I hope this is a helpful resource for
you.

Best,

Tony Johnson

# Join Us for Tonight's City Council Meeting!
Hi Neighbor, Don't forget to join us for the City Council meeting tonight at 7:30 PM! You can attend in person at College Park City Hall or watch the livestream on [YouTube](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMxNDc4MTIwMDIxNjIzODU3LFwiclwiOjEzMTQ3ODEyMDMxMTAzMTI2OH0iLCJzIjoiZDRhZjdkYjkxNmZmODdhMCJ9) or [Facebook](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMxNDc4MTIwMDI1ODE4MTYzLFwiclwiOjEzMTQ3ODEyMDMxMTAzMTI2OH0iLCJzIjoiZmU3NDQyMmM0NjAxNTA0NSJ9). **Why Attend?**
* Be there when important decisions are made. 🗳️
* Share your thoughts and ask questions. 💬
* Understand how each council member approaches key issues. 🤔

**A Few Items on the Agenda:**
* **Recycling Service Proposal** : A discussion about a new service with potential costs of $10 per home per month. ♻️
* **Drone Program Presentation** : Details on a drone soccer league that may include an educational component. ✈️
* **Consent Agenda** : Items will be voted on without discussion. 📋

We hope to see you there as we work together for a better College Park! 🌍 Let’s continue to build the city we deserve, United College Park

name: Supervisor David Canepa
subject: 2024 September e-newsletter
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
# 2024 September e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Sutter Health reopens Mickelson Warm Water Therapy Pool**
---
| Dear friends, A little more than two years ago on a hot Saturday morning in downtown San Mateo, the streets along El Camino Real were filled with the sound of music as the Raging Grannies led a chorus of a song a member wrote called “Bring back the Mickelson Pool” at a rally of about 100 supporters I held in partnership with Lindsay Raike, the founder of a nonprofit called Warm Water Wellness. We held the rally to urge Sutter Health officials to reopen the Mickelson Arthritis and Rehabilitation Center on the Mills Health Center campus that was closed due to Covid in March 2020 and which Sutter announced would permanently close June 24, 2021.
---
Today, I am extremely proud to announce that Sutter officially reopened the Mickelson pool in San Mateo Tuesday, Aug. 20 after spending $1 million this year to rehabilitate the facility. It took an incredible grassroots effort and a paradigm shift in thinking at Sutter to reopen the pool and I’m incredibly grateful to see all of the community’s efforts pay off. I want to especially thank Lindsay’s years of persistence to get us to this point. I also want to thank Warner Thomas, who assumed the reigns of CEO of Sutter Health Corporate in Sacramento in November 2022 and Darian Harris, who became CEO of the Mills-Peninsula Medical Center in Burlingame and San Mateo in July 2023 for realizing the value the pool has in San Mateo County.
---
| **County contributes $14 million for Midway Village** The largest affordable housing project in San Mateo County’s history received key financial support from the Board of Supervisors at its August 27 meeting. By a unanimous vote, supervisors approved a $14 million that will spur the construction of Phase 2 at Midway Village, located near the Cow Palace in Daly City’s Bayshore neighborhood. This is probably, in terms of housing in San Mateo County, one of the most transformative projects ever with 555 units of housing for foster youth, seniors, veterans and families. The County, through the Housing Authority, is working with partners to transform and expand Midway Village into a neighborhood that showcases affordable housing in the modern age. The new housing will also help achieve functional zero homelessness. On-site amenities will include childcare, a community garden, an exercise room, meeting space and outdoor recreation areas. Residents will include former foster youth, who will be offered an array of supportive services, as well as individuals and families and people who formerly experiences homelessness. Led by nonprofit housing developer MidPen Housing, construction of Phase 1 was completed in May 2024, providing 147 units of affordable housing, and a parking garage that will serve residents of both Phase 1 and Phase 2. Former Midway Village residents are given priority for the new housing. The latest loan approval will kickstart development of Phase 2, which includes a total of 111 units ranging from studios to four bedrooms along with two additional units for on-site managers.
---
---
|

**Groundbreaking for new North County Wellness Center**

I was honored to break the ground Thursday Aug. 29 on the new North County Wellness Center — a game-changer for health care access.

This $133 million state-of-the-art clinic will offer primary care, specialty services, optometry and dental care, adding 10,000 patient visits a year for those most in need. This is a huge win for residents in north San Mateo County who often cannot get doctor’s appointments at smaller county clinics for several months. I’m proud to have served with Supervisor Dave Pine on the subcommittee that brought this project to life.

When it opens in 2026, the center’s clinics at 1094 Mission Road in South San Francisco will primarily serve individuals and families who receive care through Medi-Cal or are eligible for Medi-Cal, which provides free or low-cost programs.

In addition to services provided by County Health and the Human Services Agency, the three-story, 77,000-square-foot building will also provide satellite offices for the District Attorney and Treasurer/Tax Collector.

The Wellness Center’s design – described by the architect as contemporary and contextual – uses an abundance of natural wood instead of synthetic materials commonly found in paneling and ceiling tiles. The timber also softens the visual impact compared to most alternatives and naturally helps to muffle the sounds of a busy office. I can’t wait to welcome the clinics first patients when it opens.
---
|

**Restauranteur slashes prices to help seniors and youth connect**

I was delighted to join Elio D’Urzo, the owner of Ristorante Sapore Italiano in downtown Burlingame, to announce a concept to help often isolated and lonely seniors connect with youth as they gather for a family-style buffet lunch and share stories in a small-town Italian setting.

D’Urzo charged only $9.99 Monday through Friday from noon to 2 p.m. (the buffet menu generally starts at $32) starting August 15 to mark the beginning of Ferragosto, a two-week summer vacation period in Italy. He told me he plans to continue this concept perhaps into the winter.

For the cost of a hamburger from a fast-food joint, Elio is creating an atmosphere where seniors, high school kids and others can make meaningful intergenerational connections as they share an incredible meal in a small-town Italian setting.

Elio understands that connecting younger and older people not only combats social isolation but also improves mental and physical well-being. If you’ve never been to Sapore, I can tell you it has become the piazza on Burlingame Avenue where you will hear lively conversations in both Italian and English and feel like you are among family.”

Learn more about Sapore here: [https://www.saporeitalianoristorante.com/about-us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=0f6a7bcee8&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **
Furry friends a remedy for loneliness**

Thank you to all who joined and participated in a special event my office hosted in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society to highlight how pets have been proven to ease loneliness, reduce stress, anxiety and depression and improves your mental and physical health. The event launched the first in my office’s “Loneliness to Light Series” that will continue into the coming months.

Having a furry friend may be the best prescription a doctor can give if you are isolated and battling loneliness. Daily walks with your dog lowers obesity rates and increases the likelihood of making meaningful connections with other people, connections that may have been lost during the pandemic.

Special thanks to Dr. Gretchen Reevy, a renowned researcher at Cal State East Bay, and Dr. Lynette Hart from UC Davis, who shared their insights on how pets can be a remedy for loneliness and improve overall well-being.

Some of you may remember in January, San Mateo County was the first in the United States to declare loneliness a public health crisis, a resolution sponsored by my office. I look forward to continuing the very important work of raising awareness on the epidemic of loneliness and how to address it.

Read an article in the Mercury News about the event:[ https://www.mercurynews.com/2024/07/26/san-mateo-county-fight-loneliness-with-furry-friends/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c1e74a02ad&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3cc674af5d&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [tbayudan@smcgov.org](mailto:tbayudan@smcgov.org) .
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=5716f4dc7e&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=30332a5c87&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a4eccdb58f&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship,
David J. Canepa
---

Supervisor David Canepa1618 Sullivan497Daly City, CA 94015

You can [update your preferences](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/profile?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&e=c0babbc643&c=17d2ca4f65) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&t=b&e=c0babbc643&c=17d2ca4f65).

Peter, all of the pundits keep asking: “Can Kamala Harris _really_ turn joy into action and win on November 5th?” **The answer is a resounding yes. Yes she can.** Our campaign’s message is one of hope and optimism for the future, and we’re proud of that. Because it’s not only a reflection of Kamala’s lifelong fight for the people -- but also a _winning strategy._ We are turning this joy into hundreds of thousands of volunteer shifts. We are turning this joy into a record number of grassroots donations. We are turning this joy into a movement strong enough to defeat Donald Trump. The pundits are right about one thing, though: We cannot get complacent. body:
Hi friend, Senators Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here! It’s crystal clear: Montana and Ohio are on the top of Mitch’s Most Wanted list. And that’s not an exaggeration – McConnell aligned super PACs made their biggest ad buy EVER in Ohio and are dropping a whopping $65 million into Montana. [**Political experts rank our elections as the most important Senate races on the map. But polls are tied in Montana and Ohio — and we need your help like never before to fight back and win. Will you donate $10 to split between our Big Sky Buckeye Fund and Wes Moore today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92093182/495974335/351679743?refcode=20240903-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWJlNjRkMy0yNDZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EmR951hcHk4mlCyeRQIDUHe95VnrBkilkqC_87vEopw=) You might be asking yourself, what’s Mitch McConnell got against a seven-fingered dirt farmer and a “disheveled” guy in a wrinkled suit? Well, it’s pretty simple: We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents and we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Friend, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, [**but just $5 can make a huge difference in this one.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=645e95ae6c9445e2802d55c4309cd702&_e=SZLKdmC4fxe-KK3PeuuidC-2XAIbhzbA3lltl6nlMAYwTha-OKs0D04aJZEm9dE7FoXpE_dq14GW77nOX3MR1_PJ1LnLcbU_I40q5emWQpsc7Ig_1eDViL7yOtXVcCiBvCe0PAM9MT5swfwT2q4vaoy3StvU0ifZBYhsofZEd16Ct-MBiIOijXN5I0qojpm-0ld7tDfd0YkjNZ5Se32a0YIx4P2UeyQKMzBZ0yxLNA2mZ1XAZcag3HmV7VfoRznUq5O8moYbp8zSS1sT03v98QtkPTtZwVZf0kNN5JOaxxTBdhv0lBJvnqCfpCZgQIp3Drl06NY6s7SAcLbIXs2foj0Cf4MgGK9x1oKn5sHwHe75VpwYKzACmvaKxnp66Apw_K_Z0EgXyIOtyFhbm-de4FXf9xdZNmBeDtWyV0iR0jvZoO0txjKoyBEutGUKWi9F) We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further.

A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election.

[**Every dollar really does make a difference here.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=645e95ae6c9445e2802d55c4309cd702&_e=SZLKdmC4fxe-KK3PeuuidC-2XAIbhzbA3lltl6nlMAYwTha-OKs0D04aJZEm9dE7FoXpE_dq14GW77nOX3MR1_PJ1LnLcbU_I40q5emWQpsc7Ig_1eDViL7yOtXVcCiBvCe0PAM9MT5swfwT2q4vaoy3StvU0ifZBYhsofZEd16Ct-MBiIOijXN5I0qojpm-0ld7tDfd0YkjNZ5Se32a0YIx4P2UeyQKMzBZ0yxLNA2mZ1XAZcag3HmV7VfoRznUq5O8moYbp8zSS1sT03v98ZCgH2Yjbi7IJCJvZldoW41_gIeOT70Tu6FTAkvuHI5UGm---5i26Tx8VJaYTdy8EN13HFtJWkJLqMZJX0Wrnk6YBi1fb5q8YsIrInbnrv-Om9o9srj8OOs8QTSbjF4yXXsPSYOuJQiuWEll6KapX32uNxz65yHHE-CAi-U-z3qi)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico , but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing. I’ll be frank-- We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race. Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us. Friend, here are the key takeaways: State of the Race: New Mexico Senate 1. This is a resource campaign. Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up. 2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella. 3. Heinrich has no room to grow. More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.” 4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually improved among Republicans without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters. Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further. A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. | Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ad5622b6c39b45caa76aec5d3c1a4c67&_e=hJR_HluGIosE2lh5xqRafp5_2-I5yd_9ra_4GcIeK6nhTCtCpYbs44hiT_p7vP2yN7cEju_W0iYrZ34ELv_IQu14tid3vekOqUGhT_xZZZBPSSInsZFLqRX5Syf0UEAOcLJMwbJ-bDfa93mamUoVVKN0j3Yn3pWy0VQWEe0MMtrM8rcg1KfOQzM3l_SGo0akPHe7ziIBnf6JIvd1NXoR37mG6sGTXUp2BruEFDA1voMnqfc91qzkfjp-IoVCv7yD1PA6Rvl2n-65jXoskCeTegQ2xtTliN9ByUtoXYxdALeKLtkSDPN70ISrOj5L43f_cRYHnD-_LyMpyRIOMkEsPW9d2vSoyzPd44dUMS6mHMLDMesSwVrdP5pfSjo6Is5ZtSjztVcqRUwJJNYwH0KEmhYsI0apVQ-xU1pjTwodDJo%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ad5622b6c39b45caa76aec5d3c1a4c67&_e=hJR_HluGIosE2lh5xqRafp5_2-I5yd_9ra_4GcIeK6nhTCtCpYbs44hiT_p7vP2yN7cEju_W0iYrZ34ELv_IQu14tid3vekOqUGhT_xZZZBPSSInsZFLqRX5Syf0UEAOcLJMwbJ-bDfa93mamUoVVKN0j3Yn3pWy0VQWEe0MMtrM8rcg1KfOQzM3l_SGo0akPHe7ziIBnf6JIvd1NXoR37mG6sGTXUp2BruEFDA1voMnqfc91qzkfjp-IoVCv7yD1PA6Rvl2n-65jXoskCeTemmRNh-nS6kWsAqReTuaISYCPnW3uT89XYkRa98ABafBaw7-peWK6W5heWrepxjhxf037x_z6EqGang0ONYtLm5GdjIf-3CGDF7lJXCT9kM8dAk-TqVRjmS307nXqw2MK92wRWc8q96_0fpFh97V-38%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ad5622b6c39b45caa76aec5d3c1a4c67&_e=hJR_HluGIosE2lh5xqRafp5_2-I5yd_9ra_4GcIeK6nhTCtCpYbs44hiT_p7vP2yN7cEju_W0iYrZ34ELv_IQu14tid3vekOqUGhT_xZZZBPSSInsZFLqRX5Syf0UEAOcLJMwbJ-bDfa93mamUoVVKN0j3Yn3pWy0VQWEe0MMtrM8rcg1KfOQzM3l_SGo0akPHe7ziIBnf6JIvd1NXoR37mG6sGTXUp2BruEFDA1voMnqfc91qzkfjp-IoVCv7yD1PA6Rvl2n-65jXoskCeTev-PEV8F_K8EE0mZ0hc4Op5gxlVI2hU42WO2yLVdnfTyrsXpOvfK5XxjE8ZI5GPNU4GpR687PT4cEWOzahEPOaurfQzNU8gbatUe2eufG4B0XB2VBq4cSaDh-9jiGTAnzxs1vYYH3TjvHyO3Vth1F6Y%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson

I just want to start this month by saying thank you. _Truly._ My organization, the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, is working around the clock to make this election year truly remarkable for the climate movement, and your dedication to our mission is making a real difference. You deserve to know exactly what your support has been helping us accomplish, so I wanted to take this moment to share an update on what my team has been up to lately:
* * *
**Primary Election Results** **In Arizona,** we achieved a clean sweep in the July 30 primary, with all 11 of our endorsed candidates advancing to the general election, paving the path to secure a pro-climate majority in November. **In Michigan,** our four endorsed climate champions also won their primaries, ensuring that the momentum for clean energy and environmental reforms continues to build. **In Texas,** Molly Cook made history as the first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas State Senate by winning the District 15 special election. **And in California,** Laura Friedman emerged victorious in a competitive 15-way primary to succeed Adam Schiff in Congress. **Our Latest Endorsements in Colorado and California** JanePAC recently endorsed a powerful slate of local climate champions who are pivotal to the future of both Colorado and California’s climate efforts. These states face enormous challenges: Colorado is home to some of the most polluted zip codes in the country, with communities like Commerce City where children are suffering from asthma and respiratory illnesses caused by corporate polluters. Despite being a “blue” state, Colorado isn’t a _green_ state. State government continues to ramp up oil and gas exports, so it’s clear that local leadership is more crucial than ever. In California, the battle is just as intense. As one of the nation’s top oil-drilling states, California has seen oil giants like Chevron, ExxonMobil, and Shell pour millions into defeating climate-minded candidates. Californians deserve leaders who will fight back against these polluters and prioritize the health of their communities. **[If you want to learn more about these candidates and how you can help them win their races, click here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92096356/495985913/-1247633444?refcode=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwYjlkZTk2LTJhNmEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NueVooVMa-0bx0_10SCGmHW7rAC5mYe_LQnZf0cZ5Qk=&emci=fd9d3fbd-e466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** **JanePAC has already endorsed over 60 candidates at every level of government.** Each endorsement is strategic in that the policy implications for climate are immediate and tangible, and every candidate has a path to victory. We're also proud to provide crucial financial resources to the candidates we endorse — a commitment that’s only possible because of the grassroots supporters like YOU who donate to JanePAC. And this is just the beginning. We have a major lineup of endorsements coming up this month, so keep an eye out! **[You can always check out our latest endorsements and see who we’re supporting here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92096357/495985914/1328794144?home&refcode=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwYjlkZTk2LTJhNmEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NueVooVMa-0bx0_10SCGmHW7rAC5mYe_LQnZf0cZ5Qk=&emci=fd9d3fbd-e466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105#endorsements)** With Election Day just around the corner, it’s going to take all of us working together to push these climate champions across the finish line. **JanePAC on the ground** Last month, we also held some incredible volunteer recruitment events. From packed houses in Los Angeles to a virtual rally that connected passionate climate advocates from all over the country, we’ve been bringing people together to build the grassroots power we need to win this November! If you’re interested in joining our volunteer team, you can check out our opportunities **[here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92096358/495985915/-907986478?refcode=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwYjlkZTk2LTJhNmEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NueVooVMa-0bx0_10SCGmHW7rAC5mYe_LQnZf0cZ5Qk=&emci=fd9d3fbd-e466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=80b9de96-2a6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)**
* * *
This is what the power of your support looks like. Don’t get me wrong — there’s still a lot of work ahead, and the road won't be easy but I’ve never been more hopeful. With you by my side, I believe we can break free from the greedy clutches of the fossil fuel industry and create a sustainable future. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-mitchell [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-mitchell]
The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep VA blue!
Friends,
I’m proud to support Ken Mitchell’s campaign for U.S. Congress! Ken is a father, veteran, entrepreneur, and farmer running to serve the people of the Shenandoah Valley and Virginia’s 6th District in Washington.
Ken will need our help to flip Virginia’s 6th District district blue. Will you split a donation of any amount between my campaign and Ken’s right now to power our work through November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-mitchell]
Ken comes from a proud military family. At 18, he enlisted in the Air Force and spent the next 24 years proudly serving his country. Once retired, Ken settled on a small farm in Rockingham County to take up organic farming — but the January 6th attacks on the Capitol changed his path.
Ken is running for office to restore integrity in government and better represent the values of his community . While in Congress, Ken will work to revitalize the economy, create job opportunities for all Americans, and invest in rural infrastructure. He’ll fight for every student to access high-quality public education, for every community to stay safe from gun violence, and for women’s reproductive freedoms to be protected.
Ken believes that if we don’t get back to pragmatic problem-solving, mutual respect, and putting our country before party, our democracy will not survive.
I agree with him, and I’d be proud and honored to work alongside him in Congress — but we will need your help to flip this red district blue in November.
Please, will you split a donation of any amount between our campaigns, and together we can help elect Ken and flip the House blue on Election Day? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-mitchell]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-mitchell]
Thanks for helping elect strong Virginia leaders this November.
-Tim Kaine

body:
It was four years ago today that Trump’s comments calling fallen Marines “suckers” and “losers” came to light.
#
**It was four years ago today that Trump’s comments calling fallen Marines “suckers” and “losers” came to light.**
It’s a disgraceful anniversary, and a lot has happened since then.
Trump’s own former Chief of Staff John Kelly confirmed the comments, and that Trump asked at the grave of Kelly’s fallen son: “I don’t get it. What was in it for them?”
Trump refused to be seen with combat-wounded Troops as president, saying: “It doesn’t look good for me.”
Trump tried to steal an election and launched an insurrection at the Capitol when he failed, a day that ranks alongside Pearl Harbor and 9/11 in its infamy.
More recently, Trump degraded the Medal of Honor and all who earned it.
Just last week, Trump desecrated Arlington National Cemetery and his campaign assaulted a cemetery official, all for a political photo op.
But some good things have happened since then, too.
We got the PACT Act across the finish line, and a million Veterans have received treatment for toxic exposures.
We protected the VA from cuts under the Trump administration and stopped cold renewed efforts from the Republican-controlled House and far-right Senators like Trump’s own VP pick, JD Vance.
Oh yeah, and one more thing... We defeated Trump.
When VoteVets picks a fight, we win. And we’ve got Trump’s number.

Thanks,
The team at VoteVets

subject: This is a new low, even for Jim Jordan
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
If you think Jim Jordan’s abuse of power is bad now, just imagine what he’ll do if he becomes Speaker of the House.
Jim Jordan isn’t interested in justice — he’s only interested in doing Trump’s dirty work, and his latest move proves it.
Last week, Jordan subpoenaed the daughter of a judge presiding over Trump’s hush-money trial, Loren Merchan, who runs a political consulting firm that has worked with Democratic candidates in the past.
Jordan is trying to twist this connection into some sort of conspiracy against Trump despite there being no evidence whatsoever of any wrongdoing.
By dragging Merchan’s daughter into the spotlight, Jordan is sending a chilling message: if you oppose Trump, he’ll come after not just you but your family, too.
It’s clear Jordan is more interested in being Trump’s personal attack dog and rigging the justice system than he is concerned about the rule of law.
Unlike Jim Jordan, this campaign is powered by people, not special interests or corrupt agendas. name: Mark Kelly
subject: It’s hard to believe a former President is capable of something like this.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Our national military cemeteries are some of our most sacred places, and Arlington is arguably the most sacred of all. They belong to every American.
#

Team —
I am appalled at what Donald Trump and his campaign did at Arlington National Cemetery last week.
They took pictures and videos of the gravestones of fallen Americans without the clear permission of their families. They posted those pictures and videos to their campaign pages. And the Army has confirmed that they physically pushed aside and verbally abused the Arlington official who attempted to prevent it.
Our national military cemeteries are some of our most sacred places, and Arlington is arguably the most sacred of them all. It belongs to every American. It is a place for unity and respect, not political photo ops. There are federal laws intended to prevent just the same violations that Trump and his campaign committed last Monday.
To me, personally, this is deeply disturbing. It’s an affront to the sanctity of Arlington National Cemetery, but it’s also a sign of deep disrespect for the fallen, to veterans, and to their families. That’s exactly what we have come to expect from Donald Trump, who has called veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice overseas “suckers” and “losers.” He doesn’t understand the sacrifices our service members make and doesn’t care about them unless he can exploit them.
As far as I’m concerned, he can never be Commander in Chief. But I’ve got to level with you: Right now, he is tied with Kamala Harris in my home state of Arizona. I don’t pay too much attention to polls, but it’s impossible to ignore that Arizona looks like the most competitive state in the entire country right now.
We’ve got to defeat Trump here to have any chance of stopping him. So, today, I’m hoping you’ll help me support Vice President Harris and I as we work together to make sure Trump is defeated, once and for all.
[**If you’re as driven as I am to prevent Donald Trump from becoming Commander in Chief, split a donation between my campaign and the Harris-Walz campaign right away. We’ll put it to good use — that’s a promise.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-harris.DNvRSt&refcode=em240903-1-120&t=1&akid=5871%2E6688874%2Eq383UD)

Friend, I want to take a moment to welcome Ohio students, educators, administrators, and staff back to school. Educators and staff have spent the summer preparing their classrooms and lesson plans, and now, it’s finally time to hit the ground running.
Teachers have always answered the call to serve, going above and beyond to ensure our children have a foundation of skills and tools that will last a lifetime – and I'm grateful for their tireless dedication to our students and their futures.

| | | **WA Ranked Most Dangerous – It’s Time to Support Law Enforcement**
---

Dear Peter,
Recent reports have ranked Washington as the most dangerous state in the USA, and this is unacceptable. Our families deserve to feel safe in their communities, but rising crime rates and a lack of support for law enforcement have put our safety at risk.

What has Kim Schrier done to support law enforcement? In 2022, she voted to defund the police and voted against the Police Act of 2023. As the only candidate with the WACOPs and the King County Police Guild’s endorsement I stand ready to support law enforcement in Congress. We believe in fully supporting our brave law enforcement officers, giving them the tools and resources they need to protect us, and ensuring that criminals are held accountable for their actions.

But we can’t do this alone. We need your help to stand up against those who would defund the police and weaken our security.

Our elections are the cornerstone of our republic, and their integrity must be protected at all costs.

Dear
Peter,
Our elections are the cornerstone of our republic, and their integrity must be protected at all costs. The SAVE Act, which I proudly support, ensures that only American citizens are allowed to register to vote. Noncitizens have been exploiting loopholes in our current system, threatening the very foundation of our democratic process.

With over 70% of Americans agreeing that noncitizens should not be able to vote, it's clear that we need to take action now. Your support is critical in this fight to uphold the rule of law and protect our elections from illegal interference.

Help us ensure that only American voices are heard in our elections. Stand with me and donate today to support election integrity.

name: Carolina at United We Dream Action
subject: 7 years ago this week
body:
It’s been 7 years since the Trump administration tried to end DACA | | | Peter, Seven years ago this week, the Trump administration tried to end DACA, tearing apart the lives of countless immigrant families. For so many undocumented folks, DACA is more than just a policy — it’s a lifeline. DACA opened doors that had been firmly shut to undocumented immigrants, and allowed them to live, work, study, and pursue their dreams free from the threat of deportation. But with one stroke of a pen, the Trump administration attempted to take all of that away, pushing an anti-immigrant agenda that ignored the fact that immigrants are the very fabric of our nation. **This is why United We Dream Action and our allies fought back and took this battle to the Supreme Court — and won. Ever since, we have always reaffirmed _DACA is right and legal, and we are here to stay_.** But we know DACA has always been a band-aid. And while Trump’s actions didn’t completely end DACA, the program became vulnerable to attacks from right-wing administrations and judges that severely weakened the program — ultimately shutting down the program to new applicants and leaving millions of undocumented individuals with no protection. This anniversary is a reminder that it’s time for _more_ than temporary fixes. We need a pathway to citizenship that offers real, lasting protections for all 11 million undocumented people and United We Dream Action is leading the fight for permanent solutions — but we’re going to need a lot of help to make this a reality. **[Peter, will you chip in $10 or more to help fuel the fight for a clear pathway to citizenship?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvb4hkAYJZF_D7tTtBfTx44Ll2qi1gZ-huyN6LV-y0HITExkHYAuOSE9b6PJ-89Bn0MWEdlw2q80OMbSMu46RwgyVO0XPZVxuSJmbKhjLEXNYkriGYn3_RhVS2xefDaDxEY-YttReNR3QY4G2Ep8Iga4yCLUG0SPKhUMVvndTf1-8WhMJbA9LVnY8a7QhtPO3fYli2kLivcrw_kyoZiRusAOmsuj84Jf7y-gxDTzoTphC_7tmZxStgQhnCkw4s7NdCBrYNvtGpJREslOatigs1jP8a5-M3cu-Tz_yXmY6BamSTuszXTTQHtFYsrIUysitFXPmv6qwLABSme9eYjmIH_fEyZv9hsinJYeJIrc3Mxng/49g/-Zaf8trTQIOtfWSFNKcBOA/h0/h001.BTxTv6KXAlISbs98t5SoQ-6XUH64x2K8eLrYKCQPmCo)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [express donate: $10](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvb4hkAYJZF_D7tTtBfTx44Ll2qi1gZ-huyN6LV-y0HITExkHYAuOSE9b6PJ-89Bn0MWEdlw2q80OMbSMu46RwgYhF30eJxCrqEHL9n_iUAZYUD-0aQYtnOUXy2sfh7CklZUSKSkvGTJkULse2UFB4GyZ0vCRRNFzHiPhptNjcTmTb_GE3GY1jvRrGUqkLwTpzFfohvQWgYkjIG6Fu5kQFsrZ10JFQRG5Rco-gArhukIFZ6DdHEORT2JiXwCQbStqiI0vfnYMOlOwg1bnlihi6rFbrLbSffY5Xznra6GVYKkro8jjvB-GQ-rFz5nUxCcSojQ0CYMJtOBLvgLUSz_dLBqyDfAAnT-nstn7D-GUUC2w6oTAU3VFGCmqdq0WYoR_M/49g/-Zaf8trTQIOtfWSFNKcBOA/h1/h001.sl1Xq7cSgRh5cVqpIwPvixxuBnYaOMGIYskn0oLRUp0)

I’ve seen firsthand the impact this crisis has on hardworking families who are forced to make impossible choices between paying rent and buying groceries or between affording childcare and keeping the lights on. | We had outstanding candidates up and down the ballot, and are deeply grateful to each of them for dedicating their time and energy to driving change in the Commonwealth. We cannot express our gratitude enough for candidates who worked incredibly hard to provide voters with a choice at the ballot box.
A special congratulations to John Deaton for securing the Republican nomination to challenge Elizabeth Warren this November! Senator Warren has built a career on dividing people and inciting class conflict, all while voting for policies that have fueled inflation and weakened our nation. We look forward to seeing Deaton hold her accountable and reveal to Massachusetts residents who Elizabeth Warren truly is.
To our candidates preparing to take on the Democratic supermajority this November, we stand ready to support your efforts to deliver a powerful blow to their dominance and restore much-needed commonsense to the legislature. Peter, I’ll make it quick today. Here are just five sentences that sum up how I’m feeling heading into the fall of a presidential election year:
1. The maps that we will be voting on in November are fairer than ever.
2. This is great news for democracy and we have a good shot at electing leaders that will hold the line against MAGA policies and continue to fight for fair maps.
3. **But voters _have_ to show up — so we _have_ to help get out the vote. **
4. Gerrymandering still poses a critical threat to our democracy, with opponents of fair maps actively undermining redistricting reforms, electing Election Deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws.
5. With Trump’s MAGA allies up and down the ballot across the country, we need you now, Peter.

Patriot,

Comrade Kamala Harris’ campaign recently shared a clip of me speaking on my podcast, Please Call Me Crazy, where I humorously referenced that women had become too mouthy.

The Fake News Media has spun what was a tongue-in-cheek moment into a full-on character assassination attempt against me.

Friends,
Earlier today, the Oklahoma Freedom Caucus became the 12th state to join the Network - officially launching on the front steps of the state capitol in Oklahoma City!
Joining me to help celebrate was Congressman Josh Brecheen (OK-02), a member of the House Freedom Caucus in DC.
The OK Freedom Caucus will be led by three conservative stalwarts - State Senator Shane Jett (chairman), State Senator Dusty Deevers (vice-chair), and State Rep. Jim Olsen (vice-chair). Other freedom caucus members in attendance were State Sens. Nathan Dahm and Dana Prieto.
The Federalist [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/d3157617-db8c-4380-aaf0-ccf36b19322d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the event.
> Conservatives are "tired of woke values being shoved down our throats, even in a red state. They're tired of Republican establishment politicians who campaign like they're Tom Coburn, but govern like they're Mitt Romney, " GOP Sen. Dusty Deevers, vice chair of OKFC, said.
And the Left in Oklahoma is already calling them "extreme" simply because the voters elected more conservative candidates. From [the local Fox affiliate](https://substack.com/redirect/227ce1cd-6b57-48a2-a0a0-68051ff9dc41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> House Minority Leader Cyndi Munson (D-OKC) told Fox25 the caucus doesn't come as a surprise given how the primary election went for some Republican incumbents.
> "When groups like this come together, it tells me and I think it signals to all Oklahomans that the Republican caucuses are moving more to the right and possibly more extreme," Munson said.
The Blaze's Daniel Horowitz, a great friend of the Network, shares our excitement for the new Oklahoma Freedom Caucus and expressed the urgency that is needed:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9455e50a-20be-4df6-969e-ae36128fb087?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you want to follow the Oklahoma Freedom Caucus on Twitter/X, go [here](https://substack.com/redirect/7e99488b-166a-41a6-adc5-2dc557f87691?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On to the next state. We won't stop until we're in all fifty!
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/172a3497-22c4-4dc2-9cf0-95f4896b3739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_
P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation's state capitols and in your home state. Please consider a [contribution](https://substack.com/redirect/cc06b7a5-0446-4fd7-8022-156c2667f43a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and join us as we work to advance the cause of liberty.

Sherrod’s opponent is a wealthy Republican who hopes to buy the title “Senator” with the help of billionaire and special interest donors who expect legislative payback. Does he know that public service means serving the public? Or what it’s like for a family to agonize over a budget? Sherrod does.
If Moreno wins, he’d give Republicans the majority they need to lower taxes for billionaires, while raising taxes for median Americans. Republicans want to defund the Department of Education and enact a national book ban. Moreno’s vote would put Republicans in our bedrooms and restrict access to emergency rooms.
[**If you don’t want this outcome, you have the power to prevent it.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92105931/496018533/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2738-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTc5ZmM5Yy00MDZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KgUw6utjbwRIzCwtJU1DWpILoLfcfhtoxfAF-UhNRCE=)
Friend, I lived in a rural county in Idaho for 38 years. Most of my neighbors voted for Republicans, and they knew I supported Democrats. But when my car broke down, they’d stop and make sure I got back on the road. And when a fire destroyed someone’s home, I sang on a flatbed trailer at a gathering to help him out.
That’s what good neighbors do.
Folks in the Buckeye State and all Americans need Sherrod back in the Senate because he’s the best kind of neighbor: He uses his experience as a public servant to make our experiences better. More of _that_ , please.
Thank you for hearing me out and hopefully [**helping**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92105933/496018535/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2738-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTc5ZmM5Yy00MDZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KgUw6utjbwRIzCwtJU1DWpILoLfcfhtoxfAF-UhNRCE=). subject: Why this is so important to me
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I had an idea of what this would be like, but I’ve got to tell you: nothing prepared me for the pace we’ve been going over the last few months.
#

Peter -
I thought I knew what I was getting into when I announced my campaign last year. I had run for Congress already and spent a decade serving in the House.
I had an idea of what this would be like, but I’ve got to tell you: nothing prepared me for the pace we’ve been going over the last few months.
It seems like every day there’s a new attack ad with millions of dollars behind it. Kari Lake spends all of her time tearing me down online and in far-right media. Trump himself has attacked me, personally, and set the MAGA-right on me. It’s a lot.
My friends ask me why I’d put myself through all of that. But to me, it’s simple.
My immigrant mother raised me and my three sisters on a secretary’s salary. I slept on the floor growing up, and now I am here. I am in a position to give back to the country that has done so much for me.
How could I not?
I am committed to this, and I am so grateful you’ve had my back so far. But today, with our most important FEC deadline of the entire campaign approaching, I need you to make your first donation to my campaign.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, it’s not
inflation when corporations are raking in record profits.

Last year, corporate profits hit a record high of $2.8 TRILLION after
taxes — all while charging outrageously high prices for gas, rent, food,
and prescription drugs.

This level of greed is disgusting, and Americans are sick of getting
ripped off!

Bernie Sanders is sick of it too, and has introduced legislation for a 95
percent windfall tax on the excessive profits of large corporations that
are using inflation as an excuse to charge the American people outrageous
prices.

Had this been in effect in 2023, it would have raised an estimated $300
billion in one year from ten of the largest corporations alone!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18443?source=email-20240903&t=1011&akid=6694%2E5885482%2EYqxpoy ]Stand with Bernie: Congress must pass Bernie’s Ending Corporate Greed
Act now!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18443?source=email-20240903&t=1012&akid=6694%2E5885482%2EYqxpoy ]ADD YOUR NAME

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18443?source=email-20240903&t=1013&akid=6694%2E5885482%2EYqxpoy ][IMG]

While we pay more for the necessities of life, big corporations are
spending record amounts on buying back their own stocks with their excess
profits.

In fact, corporations spent $4.4 TRILLION on stock buybacks this past year
— that’s 7x more than they paid in taxes!

Bernie and our progressive movement have successfully put this issue on
the table in Washington and made it popular with the majority of
Americans. Let’s keep pushing for a win against corporate greed!

MESSAGE FROM BEN :

"A big “THANK YOU” to each of you for signing up for my website! The campaign is in full swing. These past few months have been the busiest time of my life. The power source of the campaign has been almost 100% volunteer-driven and we’ve been fortunate to have friends & family contributing by what they do best – whether that’s graphic design, knocking on doors, helping with FEC filing, being rockstar organizers, and of course social media gurus. Since I did not have an opponent for the August primary election, we were able to focus our energy at the county fairs informing WI voters of both constitutional amendments. We are so thrilled that Wisconsin successfully rejected both!**Many of you have reached out about upcoming fundraising events. We are currently solidifying plans for a few events this fall. Please let us know if you or someone you know would be interested in hosting an event. "**
**Wednesday, September 11th: Meet The Candidate****RSVP here: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/oconomowocevent**

---
---
|
---
This election cycle we are up against big money and elite interests. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. **We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico** , but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing.

I’ll be frank--**[right now, our biggest barrier is being underfunded.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8151a3c797414f47a3a36d9d88f150b3&_e=i4k2guDyNVYPmmP1BZA_DSI0p4rpTEk_0m2WwcIMdcc4aMwb4gE8SLXZS0XoV8yYEU5xtsbp79hdQMUJnTkpO5RsngKO2lSvrSWYxToH5DMUJOROVQN7d8CiPE3JIPzBKL7l1OP_GBrpMoyCEIPZGroP9lqYUIT5Xuz-GKcR08eLo6PulSDMfN3Zc3Efen55jkIDbmSwzw1h5Bzdawm0CVB1k2hxgx45vE6MPHlgmuSSZAZQX0OjExpYdNki5iblkWNyzGgDg3q0lm9qPnlIB84KsFjQPDgo3eR-d54dm_LE4pno7suhS6zXCiBKnIAyV_RfU-TdlcIYqU4-NpVeHndVc8T1sUnAVJ6S6T15JdVXV2llfz5A8-kMd87IiF4eJi8k-BF2WHVuzQfGKEhgVInWi8fJvkp8i8fQ08j0kpQrkTB8n7hAxg0tXktSWHtL)** We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Peter, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
| Hey there!

Team Warmington here! Our campaign is gaining momentum, and we’re calling on all our supporters across the Granite State to step up as we approach Election Day **_just one week from today!_**
